## Decision A answered · 2026-10-15

Maintainer, in the epic PM session on 2026-10-15, verbatim:

> A、B、C 三项全按设计稿裁定：权限进导航、More 退役；Advanced 扁平成七个标签；权限页改五个标签。记到专题卡上。

Decision A is the first clause: Access becomes the fourth segment of the pillar nav and More retires. The full record, with the premise to re-check (`OVERFLOW_PILLARS` holds exactly one pillar), is on the epic objectstack-ai/objectui#12446. This card is no longer held on a decision; it stays blocked on #12459 (objectstack-ai/objectui#12460, enqueued) and is dispatched once that lands. The body's hold sentence is refreshed in the same stroke.

No other open PR touches `studio-design/` (3 open PRs read).
